query:
UPDATE quotation
                            SET span_start    = $2,
                                span_end      = $3,
                                highlight_start = $4,
                                highlight_end   = $5,
                                definition    = $6,
                                notes         = $7,
                                updated_by    = $8,
                                updated_at    = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                            WHERE id = $1 AND translation = $9
